main_text.p: attingitur: in Topicis infinite iteratur, ut p fingulas fpecies dicetur; in Phyficis vero nomine hujus argumenti, multa etiam cumulantur. Quod principia fint cotraria : item τὰ ἐναντία τῶν ἐναντίων αἴτια ἔναι, adverfas adverforu cauffasef-5fe,ut 10.cap. 2.de Generatione: item 7. & 8.cap. 4.Meteororum: quod fpecialiter etiam propofitum,generaliter oporteat intelligi:tum de adverfis motibus multa eft in Philofophia illa difputatio. Quare ut materies illa a P. Ramo fecundum Ariftotelis leges & principia fit explicata,ut genera generumq; fpecies generatim & fpeciatim propofitæ, qualis deniq; agricultura fit,attendamus. Confentanea argumenta,ufum magnum habuêre:Diffentaneorū autem quantus fit ufus,declarant Grecorum & Latinorum fcripta innumerabilia,quæ feré tota funt in refutatione errorū & falfarū opinionū : quód é diffentaneis fieri neceffe fit:pars pexigua eft in confirmatione:& quidem ipfa multo fepius etiam é 10 diffentaneis petitur, vel in fchola mathematica, quæ ipfa multo feverioris Logicæ fibi leges impofuit:attamē demonftrationes per impofsibile ex diffentaneorū Topicis deductæ funt. Qua re ut categoria confentaneorum priores digni-15tatis partes obtinebit,ita categoria diffentaneorum, copiæ & ubertatis opib. longé fuperabit. Diffentaneorum aút doctrina, quamvis fit posterior,quám doctrina cófentaneorū:attamē eft etiam primorum argumentorum, quę re ipfa fe 20 parata effe poffunt à cófentaneis. Diffentanea funt diverfa.]Categoria diffentaneorum prima parti-25tione

page.notes: Right-hand printed page 89 with the second column of the page; the marginal numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 are line numbers, not notes. Greek words in the line near the top are partly illegible in the scan and are transcribed approximately. The 'f 5' at the foot is a signature mark and the word 'tione' is a catchword at the bottom right. Some lines are damaged at the spine edge. Right-side manuscript annotations on the binding edge are not printed text and are omitted.
